choreography.condition: The definition baseline is approved and Design activation inputs are present.
Normal planning requires design-validator-pass; remediation planning is explicitly bounded.
Handoff preserves continuity but is not an additional lifecycle stage.
Refresh updates or proposes exact artifact state and never substitutes for target execution.

deferred_operations.reason: The canonical mode and capability table mark Full deferred and unsupported; routes naming Full do not make it active.
The canonical mode and capability table mark Validate deferred and unsupported.

invariants: Exactly five operations are active; Full and Validate remain deferred and undecomposed.
Every active operation realizes exactly one existing B-* outcome or workflow without duplicating its claim.
Required, conditional, optional, and next-owner capability roles remain distinct.
Artifacts, templates, receipts, validators, and projections are operation inputs or outputs, not supporting business capabilities.
Handoff and Refresh sequences are derived and cannot be presented as canonical phase tables.
Dispatch trace is required for every active operation; Distill follows its mode-specific trigger.
Define identity-denominator evidence is required when exact or canonical ID-to-label meaning is asserted.
Execution-candidate Plan requires current WPRA and Implementation Readiness proof; non-executing Plan cannot expose Task Session.
Exact owner-request emission remains blocked until preacceptance closure, independent review, and reflection-adoption evidence pass.
Phase status, handoff readiness, and durable capability axes never collapse into one readiness label.
Every next route preserves a separate owner and never implies Invoke completed that owner's lifecycle.
operation_composition.model: Each operation is a composite business behavior owned by B-AUTHORING. It references an existing B-* outcome or workflow, orders mode activities, binds supporting capabilities by obligation, and stops at the downstream-owner boundary.

relation_semantics.governed_by: The operation remains subject to the referenced business rule or policy.
relation_semantics.hands_off_to: The operation transfers bounded artifacts or context to a separate lifecycle owner.
relation_semantics.preconditioned_by: The operation requires the referenced prior business outcome or evidence state.
relation_semantics.realizes: The operation produces or maintains the referenced business outcome or workflow.
relation_semantics.supported_by: A normalized capability contributes a bounded business function without becoming the operation owner.
